name: Cinnamoroll
author: zhou-jianwen
variant_note: An independently AI-generated flat-cartoon V2 fan interpretation with nine task animations and sixteen clockwise look directions. This supplies only the Cinnamoroll portion of mixed-character request #311.
description: An unofficial, independently AI-generated Cinnamoroll fan companion with a white rounded body, long drooping ears, blue oval eyes, pink cheeks, and a cinnamon-roll tail. zhou-jianwen is the independent AI-assisted adapter, not Sanrio or the character designer.
source_notes: The official Sanrio character page and its gallery image (https://sanrio.com.cn/images/family/4/kv1.jpg) were used only as appearance references for the central white puppy. No gallery pixels or other gallery characters are included. Sprite pixels were independently generated with the built-in image_gen tool, followed by native-alpha extraction, whole-pose retiling for spacing, and deterministic shared-scale V2 assembly. The left locomotion animation was mirrored from the right animation for this symmetric character. Request #311 also names other Sanrio characters; this package is limited to Cinnamoroll and does not establish completion of the whole request.
